resumeInstructions: Read root AGENTS.md, activate pinned Bun and run cloud:start.
Run workflow:context interview and read every required source, especially this checkpoint and the student DB architecture.
Recover the user's latest concrete example from the source chat when needed; never rediscover identities by raw scans.
Start interviews from the confirmed KG/Ontology goal; do not reask project purpose, hierarchy, schedule or cohort display.
Treat SQLite and the preclass UX as prototypes. Keep provider selection open and perform no migration/provisioning before the design and target are concrete.
Check the final validation/Git receipt; local Git push403 and connector account permissions are separate observations.
